environmentVariables.description: Ledger SQLite path (default .attest/ledger.sqlite)

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to approve every confirm request (development only)

environmentVariables.description: Seconds attest_confirm waits for a human (default 900)
environmentVariables.name: ATTEST_CONFIRM_TIMEOUT

environmentVariables.description: Google OAuth access token with gmail.readonly — enables Gmail read-back
environmentVariables.name: GMAIL_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Google OAuth access token — enables Calendar / Drive / Docs / Sheets read-back
environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Slack bot token (xoxb-…) with channels:history, channels:read — enables Slack read-back
environmentVariables.name: SLACK_BOT_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: HubSpot private-app token — enables HubSpot read-back
environmentVariables.name: HUBSPOT_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Notion integration token — enables Notion read-back
environmentVariables.name: NOTION_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Linear API key — enables Linear read-back
environmentVariables.name: LINEAR_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Microsoft Graph token — enables Outlook / Teams read-back
environmentVariables.name: GRAPH_TOKEN
